carte.carte_cv_aria: Map of the universes, their systems and their planets. Spread two fingers to go in a level, pinch to go back out, tap an item to go there; the list below offers the same destinations.
agenda.cc_partiel_ou_autre: Coursework test, final exam or other, with your target grade
evol.comprendre_les_quatre_marches: Understanding the four steps of mastery
evol.chaque_chapitre_se_valide: Each chapter is validated in four steps, from the simplest to the most demanding. A step is only validated by evidence: questions answered correctly on several different days, not a single run done in one sitting.
evol.tu_les_retrouves_dans: You will find them in the “Course” tab of each subject, chapter by chapter.
prof.prof_notes_s: What you highlighted or noted in your sheets, plus your own notes
prof.prof_packs_s: A pack made by an AI from your course
prof.toute_ta_progression_dans: All your progress in one file, to keep or take elsewhere
prof.automatique_suit_le_reglage: Automatic follows your phone or computer setting.
prof.papier_une_feuille_claire: Paper: a light sheet. Night: the same sheet in dark. The rest of the app stays dark.
prof.dans_la_seance_du: In today's session, a question you got right while sure comes back without the choices: you answer from memory, then compare with the expected answer. Recalling an answer anchors it better than recognising it among four.
prof.caches_d_abord_la: Hidden first: the question appears alone, you look for the answer in your head, then tap “Show the choices”. Like in the exam, without being steered by the options. You can also turn it on for a single run, at the top of the quiz.
prof.une_idee_une_gene: An idea, an annoyance, a question
packs.une_ia_transforme_ton: An AI turns your course into a pack; the app checks it, then adds it to your subjects. The pack stays in this browser: remember to back up.
packs.colle_la_dans_l: Paste them into the AI of your choice (Claude, ChatGPT, Le Chat…) along with all the documents of a single course. It tells you what it understood, suggests an outline and asks you its questions: answer them, add your notes if you like, then say “go”.
packs.ouvre_le_fichier_du: Open the pack file it gives you, or paste its text here. Check it, then add it.
packs.nouvelles_seances_ou_correction: New lectures or a fix to a course you already imported: “Complete or update”, under that course at the bottom of the page.
sauve.toute_ta_progression_dans: All your progress in one file: your review memory, your mistakes and bookmarks, your exercises, your exams, your settings and your imported courses.
sauve.remplace_ce_qui_est: Replaces what is stored in this browser with a backup, then restarts the app.
sauve.sv_texte_ph: Paste the text of a backup here
sauve.pour_passer_a_une: To move to another version of the app (Maitrise) or to another device: your universes, your subjects with their course, your progress and your profile, in a single file.
sauve.le_fichier_tout_exporter: The “Export everything” file from another version: it replaces what the app keeps on this device.
qcm.une_question_quatre_reponses: One question, four answers, the correction right away. After you answer, say whether you are sure: that is what sets when the question comes back.
plan.pl_exam: Add or change my exam date
recherche.rch_aide: Type a word, or several: they must all be in the passage. I search the sheets, the summaries, the wording of questions, cases and exercises, the document templates, the topics and the subjects, without looking at the answers.
recherche.rch_kbd: Keyboard: ↓ to go to the results, ↑ ↓ to move between them, Enter to open, / to go back to the field.
lire.al_modif: Change the exam or its topics
cours.une_fiche_par_theme: One sheet per topic: the key points first, then the course step by step, with an example drawn from your cases. Read a topic's sheet before its questions.
fiche.sig_fi: Report an error in this sheet
docs.les_documents_de_l: The exam documents in their order, line by line: the code of each line in the tax return, and what your analysis does with it. So you know where to look for each figure on exam day.
docs.docs_q_aria: Search a line in the documents
notes.ce_que_tu_as: What you highlighted or noted in your sheets, plus your own notes. To highlight: select a passage in a sheet, then tap “+”.
conslist.tu_construis_un_tableau: You build a table as in the exam, line by line. For each line, the form appears blank: tap the box or boxes that apply, with their sign, then check. To learn to take each figure from the right place, with the right sign.
cons.cq_q_aria: Search a box in the documents
cons.cq_q_ph: Search a box: borrowings, inventory, DU…
caslist.une_situation_complete_puis: A full situation, then multiple-choice questions, step by step. To apply the course before the written exercises.
quiz.choix_title: Hide the choices for this run
quiz.rep: Where do I find this in the documents?
quiz.reflechis_d_abord_ta: Think first: your answer in mind, then look at the choices.
quiz.rl_t: Without the choices: you got it right last time while sure. Answer from memory, in your own words.
quiz.ta_reponse_disait_elle: Did your answer say the same thing?
quiz.copie_ia: Copy the question for your AI
quiz.ai_cost: Only Claude's help uses your Claude plan. The rest of the app does not.
quiz.q_kbd: Keyboard: A to D to answer, G, U or S for your confidence, Enter to continue.
result.refaire_mes_erreurs_de: Redo my mistakes from this run
drillstart.des_calculs_tires_au: Random calculations, using the figures from the course. When your answer matches a classic mistake, the screen tells you which one.
drillstart.reponds_au_calcul_sans: Answer the calculation, no calculator. Aim for under 30 seconds per question.
drillstart.les_pieges_chiffres_en: The number traps at a glance
simstart.les_regles_et_le: The rules and the programme in detail
sim.case_pleine_repondue_point: Filled box: answered. Red dot: bookmarked to come back to.
sim.sc_bro_ph: Work out your calculations here, as on an exam sheet.
ex.exrep: Where do I find this in the documents?
ex.exq_all: Ask about the whole exercise instead
ex.ex_bro_ph: Work out your calculations here, as on an exam sheet.
menu.passe_d_un_univers: Switch from one universe to another
calc.calc_aide: Enter keeps the result in the list. Operations: + − × ÷ ( ) and %.
sel.sel_cache: You haven't answered yet: Claude helps you find it without giving the answer.
sel.sel_cout: Only Claude's help uses your Claude plan.
evol.marche_comprendre_d: : know what the notions are, what they are for, and why.
evol.marche_savoir_faire_d: : apply the method to figures and reach the right result.
evol.marche_expliquer_d: : justify what you do, in your own words.
evol.marche_recommander_d: : propose a decision that fits the situation and defend it.
quiz.pause_suite: Take a 6-minute break: stand up, drink some water, no screen. Regular breaks reduce fatigue and keep you focused.
quiz.tip_q_suite: Pick your answer, then say whether you are sure. Be honest: this is what sets the date of the next review.
prof.langue_aide: Changes the language of the app and its courses. Your progress stays the same.
